notes.title: What you’re all the most interested about is probably the car update.

items.text: It was announced but never came to fruition. The original team started the early stages of development but they never completed it. This update was left in a state where it had severe technical issues, especially the vehicles’ physics were game-breakingly broken.

Recently, after our internal team had independently improved the game's technical state and addressed numerous technical issues, we looked at the possibilities related to the car update. If drivable cars make an appearance in DDS2, they will take on a new form because the code requires rewriting from scratch. That’s why we decided to remove the trailer.

We need to rethink the addition of cars, and if we choose to pursue it, start its development anew. We don’t want to cram a subpar mechanic into the game just to have it ticked off. We aim to do what’s best for the overall experience of DDS2.

To close off this subject - the most important element of DDS2 is you, the player. Thank you for being here, for the trust of players who enjoy the game, and for the critique of those who would like to see it expand. These are the crucial elements of self-improvement. We believe that where the game is now, and where it used to be on release, are checkpoints of a tremendous and still ongoing journey.
Hey there, Dealers!

We bring you a brand new update for DDS2. The bulk of it was dedicated to the missing translations across all languages. We did our best to fish out the missing translations and filled in a huge amount of text, but if you find any other instances remaining - let us know.
Resolved various localization issues and improved overall translation quality across all supported languages.
Fixed an issue where players could fall through the map when viewing a hideout interior.
Fixed an issue where custom map markers functioned incorrectly on certain screen resolutions.
Fixed an issue where police patrols could become stuck near the green SUV in Callejon.
More will come. Keep dealing!
The MG Team
Hey there, Dealers!
Our team at Movie Games is happy to bring you the next Drug Dealer Simulator 2 patch and hope to keep up the pace. Read what’s new below.
Fixed the map markers for discovered but not yet purchased hideouts which wouldn’t properly display. Now they appear on the map after approaching a “For Sale” sign near a hideout.
Fixed the issue with first customers not appearing on the map after loading the game.
Fixed the issue when, after loading the game, previously unlocked dealer spots had to be unlocked again.
Fixed the “Sales Multiplier” option in the Cartel panel not working properly.
Fixed the issue where creating a multiplayer session with the PC being offline caused a black screen.
Fixed the issue where the host exiting the game using Alt+F4 would make the guests unable to rejoin without restarting the game.
Fixed the sound options issue causing some sounds to be fully audible despite lowering the volume.
Step by step, we’re bringing the game to a higher standard and hope that your enjoyment of it grows. Have fun on Isla Sombra!
Heya Dealers, we continue our mission of improving DDS2.

notes.title: So, the new patch is now live. Here’s what’s been fixed

items.text: After changing the keybind, in-game triggers no longer show the default key.
The bug with lights flashing on medium and high Global Illumination Quality settings.
Quests “Set up a dealer’s cabinet” and “Hire your first dealer” no longer update at the wrong times.
Added a new pop-up informing about the situation that when the player first gives drugs to a dealer and then makes them a distributor, the drugs disappear and cannot be recovered.
SPOILER! – Fixed the bug when the cave thugs can attack the player after choosing their side.
Fixed the bug when queued orders show up as a black tile in a calendar.
Fixed the texture of billboards in-game.
More, as always, coming soon! Have fun playing.
Hi Dealers!
We reached the next step of our mission to elevate the DDS2 experience - and fixes are a key factor in it. Here’s what’s improved.
Fixed the issue of drugs sometimes disappearing if there’s no space in a hideout stash.
Fixed the issue where players in a co-op session could not preview the private island villa.
Fixed the issue where the jetski for embarking yachts disappeared in a co-op session when one of the players used the yacht.
Fixed the issue where the yacht would not always be moved to its new position when using fast travel.
Fixed the issue where throwing away and picking up a backpack resulted in some items disappearing from the backpack when the player had an item in the hidden slot.
Fixed the issue where hideout raids would not launch properly after a player was caught during a raid for the first time.
Fixed the issue where changing the seat in a vehicle made the previous seat unusable anymore.
Fixed the issue where yachts would become unusable after running out of fuel despite refueling.

We’re continuing to iron out the game’s technical issues. We believe that expanding a project without it being technically sound would potentially cause a lot more problems. You can’t build castles in the sand, as the saying goes. And so, we’re dedicating a lot of time to making sure the quality and stability of the fixes.

Internally, the game has many intertwined elements that resemble a very complex knot that we have to untangle. This means not only meticulous programming work, but also repeated testing. Our priorities are chosen by the criteria of problem severity (e.g. can it block an online session? Can it throw you out of the game?), and the chance of it occurring during your gameplay.

Thank you for continuing your DDS2 experience. We don’t want to hype up or oversell what we intend to fix. We believe that the game, changing for the better, should speak for itself. We’re listening to your feedback and applying it - not just in the form of DDS2 fixes, but also as features of DDS3, which is in active development.
Yours,
The MG Team
We present the first update made by our internal DDS team. More updates will follow next year.
Fixed the crash that occurred when trying to purchase an item with a placeholder icon.

Prevented the situation when saving the game while on a boat blocked the character in the boat. Please note that saves made before this update, that blocked a character, will not unlock it - this fix isn’t retroactive.

Visual options now work and apply changes to the look of the game. Note that despite this, it is known that choosing lower visual settings does not significantly improve the frame rate since the game is system-demanding in other areas. We intend to handle this in a later update.
Leaving a vehicle by a passenger no longer causes the vehicle to be permanently blocked.

Hi everyone! The work on DDS2 continues! Updates will come. After getting into the project, we narrowed down the list of bugs and improvements which we consider the most crucial for now. Below you'll see what changes are in the works.

Please note that it is not certain yet which fixes will come first, or what a single update will consist of. We'll see along the way if it'll be a couple of bigger updates or a series of smaller ones.

At the same time, please note this is only a partial list of bugs we wish to take care of. The challenge is that there is no documentation for the game, so understanding its systems and the problems they suffer from requires a lot of time and effort.
Here are the issues we want to tackle in the reasonably near future:
Most graphics options don't work - there is no change in the look or performance of the game.,
Some sounds are still audible despite silencing them in the options menu.,
Saving a game while in a vehicle blocks the player character.,
Save files may disappear, or the wrong game state may be restored after loading them.,
Buying an item with a placeholder icon crashes the game.,
Crashes upon starting the game and other selected crashes.,
Drugs may disappear if there's no space in the hideout stash.,
Drugs may disappear if the player hands over a package to a dealer and then designates him as a distributor.,
Raids may not work properly when the player gets caught during one and other selected raids issues.,
Lights pulsate when using a phone on selected global illumination quality settings.,
Yacht may not move when fast travelling.,
Jetski for yacht embarking does not spawn in co-op when a guest uses the yacht.,
In some situations, it is impossible to preview the villa on the private island.,
Enemies can hit or talk with the player through the walls.,
Unequipping and equipping a backpack removes items from it if the player has an item in a hidden slot.,
Sales Multiplier option does not work correctly in the cartel settings.,
Some clients are not shown on the map after the player loads the game.,
Custom markers do not work correctly in certain resolutions.,
Influencer drug prices are different from actual prices.,
Emergency teleporting while in a vehicle results in the player model disappearing.,
Selected quest issues.,
Having an active crafter causes FPS drops during sudden player movement.,
Add missing localization.,
As for expanding the game with content, first, we need to clean it up so new things are introduced safely.
Stay tuned for info about the progress. We are committed to improving the game and making it the best it can be, considering our resources.

items.text: Hello Dealers, we have news for you!

Crash fixes.

Fixed issue with achievement "Lucky Spin" - will now correctly unlock with payout 5:1, 8:1 and 11:1.
Fixed issue with builders spawning too early.

Dealers, it’s time for Big New Things in DDS2!
First of all: CASINO DLC IS HERE!

Explore the Wallet Drainer Casino, located at the long abandoned Big Win Oil Rig at the coast of Isla Sombra. Risk big, win big, and take over the business. Developed by True Games Syndicate, with the help of Byterunners.
In multiplayer, only the host needs to own the Casino DLC, others can join without it.
If you own the game, get Casino DLC as part of the DDS2 + Casino DLC Bundle to get a discount.
Have fun, and don’t spend your fortune in one afternoon! Check out the Player’s Guide here.
But this isn’t all.
Content / Quality-of-Life improvements
Added a new cartel creation/edition screen and the ability to select an emblem for your cartel
Added multiple new thug bosses to the world in various areas
Added distributor range visible on map when hovering a hideout, added hideout markers to the boss desk map
Added the ability to view the remaining drugs and mixes in a hideout on the map marker tooltip if the hideout has a distributor in place
Added a yard to one of the jungle hideouts
New improved lobby screen for creating new games
Clients assigned to dealers will now be automatically handled if they have an order pending in the sms list
Added display of recorded messages and pending meetings to the task list in the mobile phone screen
New view for the journal recipe search section
General broad overhaul and mastering of game UI considering readability, consistency, color coding
Rework and mastering of all UI interactive elements (tabs, buttons, input fields, dropdowns) and changed setting screen dropdown sections to left<>right switches future gamepad support
Rework of the saved game list in the main menu - added search, changed sorting from alphabetical to dates (newest to oldest), improved the readability and aesthetics of the positions
Improved boat interactions and boat docking interpretation
When responding to client sms “schedule now”, the client will now be scheduled to the current hour and spawned ASAP, not to the next hour
Changed early game enemy spawn policy to make early game dynamics and reputation handling easier
Removed the reputation penalty for killing thugs and thug bosses
Added phoneline property to most map hideouts, only excluding the most wildlife hideouts in the wild jungle. All other hideouts now have the ability to place stationary phones

Improved dealer attention list in the phone (added more readable list of lacks in stock and display of all drugs that are put in town offer, sorted by the lowest amount). Grouped the drugs and mixes to base drugs (you can still view precise drug type and mix stock for dealers in their tooltips)
Simplified the recipe for homemade bomb
Influencers will now distribute the provided dope evenly, not one-by-one (example: if you drop weed and amp, both will start to be distributed at the same time)
Added a delay of militia aggro for militia stash tasks after placing the bomb
Global improvements to lighting, lumen, post processing, anti-aliasing as well as landscape material shading
Added icons for hideout properties and simplified/improved the HUD and hideout management views
Added hiding quick slots while in dialogue
Fixed bunker bar door glitching in the frame
Improved unconscious screen and unconscious animations for the player
Multiple improvements to combat animations including combat stance, fist animations, walking animations for both players and opponents
Fixed crafting query peek remaining on the HUD
Multiple and broad graphical improvements to the entire map (interiors and exteriors)
Improved nighttime lighting for the first meeting with Billy in his villa and fixed music player on the meeting
Fixed influencer and employee avatars not displaying properly on boss desk tooltips as well as HUD and few other places
Multiple translation and text fixes
Fixed new character/pet unlock popup, added sections with proper headers for unlocked character type
Added new and different default animations for casual clients
Fixed archive and “show more” not working properly in the recorded messages list
Added the slot property for safes visible in shops so you can check their capacity
Fixed the position of trade option in merchant dialogues (moved to first)
Improved swamp fog in the slavs bay area
Improved boat map markers to make them more visible
Pets and bodyguards will now return home after you get locked in the labour camp
Multiple enviro, lighting and audio improvements for the labour camp
Improvement landscape in sea/river connections for better boat swimming experience
Nerfed regular militia combat stats
Removed low chance on one spawn for the militia to spawn in Callejon
Changes in text displaying methods
In the next big update: Vehicles. Worth the wait!
And finally…

releases.displayName: New update is here! Crashfixes & more

items.text: Hello Dealers!
As promised, we’re coming to you today with new crashfixes and a batch of additional changes! The main course is the travel crash fix, which you helped us identify and confirm the solution.

From the data you sent we know that this problem was responsible for as much as 79% of crashes. Fixing it should make a BIG difference for stability overall. (Other crash reasons will be dealt with too in future updates.)

notes.title: Let’s dive straight into Update Notes

items.text: Fixed crash related to NPCs navigation, most frequently observed when travelling, especially via vehicles;
Fixed an issue where the player could be bitten by a snake while quick-travelling;
Fixed an issue that could cause the game to save automatically during quick travel;
Fixed an issue where the player could not move after quick travel;
Added new VO for thugs, policemen and militia;
Added VO for bodyguards;

The trade dialogue option is now the first choice with shopkeepers.: Thank you all for reporting your crashes and testing out the solutions. Your help was invaluable!: Stay tuned, more updates are coming soon!
Hello, Dealers!
After a big update there’s gotta be a hotfix. So there is!
IMPORTANT: We recommend not using mods, as they can potentially cause issues in the game.
Change name of “LSD compound” to “LSD”;
Influencers now will only accept LSD (LSD compound);
Potential customers won't want LSD anymore;
Added missing translations;
Increased price and quantity of LSD produced by lab technician.
Fixed an issue where distributor sales rules cannot be set correctly for dealers in other regions than the distributor;
Fixed an issue where an NPC in the LSD questline was not visible in coop to a guest;
Fixed an issue where the client could duplicate itself;
Fixed military stash textures;
Fixed an issue where it was not possible to enter a room with a safe in a villa on a private island;
Fixed an issue where not all warehouses were marked on the minimap;
Fixed an issue where mid-tier recipes for lab tech could not be unlocked correctly;
Fixed an issue where the yacht “Caballo del Mar” may not have been properly interactive after it was purchased;
Fixed an issue where a passenger in the “Bong Voyage” yacht was sitting in the incorrect position, and after leaving the yacht, his camera was skewed;
Other minor fixes.: Happy playing!
Hi there, Dealers!

We wanted to thank you a lot for your many positive words about the latest update. Many of you shared your thoughts and the crash reporter also started collecting feedback. Thanks to all of that we can start working on fixing deeper problems and game issues.
After the update went live we’ve seen a huge number of gamers playing DDS2 at the same – we hope it’s gonna happen again many times in the future! So, thanks again.
Also, a hotfix is on its way! It’s gonna address missing translations and bugfixes.
And now, we have some bonus news to share with y’all. DDS2 is coming to PLAYSTATION®5.

Yep, you heard that right. The PlayStation 5 version of the game will contain all the PC updates, including the most recent lab technicians, advanced drug mixing, overdose mechanic, and more. And you can already find the store page over at the PS website. And DDS1 is coming soon to Xbox, too, with DDS2 to follow later.

Hello there, Dealers!
It’s the first day of our Holiday Madness, and we’re starting off with an update for the base Drug Dealer Simulator 2!
New achievements;
Bodyguards;
Account history;
Employee stats.
And more pach notes are right here ↓
Bodyguard mechanic
You will now be able to assign your employees to a bodyguard role;
You will be able to give them commands, set their combat behaviour, equip them with weapons and meds, and use them for transporting stuff around;
They have their own dedicated station that you have to purchase in one of your hideouts;
There is no hard limit to how many bodyguards can follow you at the same time.
Boss desk improvement
Added a feature to view general cartel stats in the boss desk;
Employee status screen with information such as current assigmnent, location and possessions;
Wealth payment history;
Further improvements to the boss desk will be added in future updates. Suggestions are welcome!
New Steam achievements, including the ones posted by you
Added unique voicelines for distributors and lab technicians
Fixed a bug where you couldn't place furniture in a hideout if you docked a boat too close to it.
And now, for the first look at bodyguards...!
See them in action - in the game.
It's DAY ONE of Holiday Madness. Stay tuned for more!

releases.displayName: New update is live! Fixes and quality-of-life improvements

items.text: Dear dealers!

We present to you the newest update from the team behind DDS2. This time the patch focuses on upgrading some features as well as introducing some quality of life changes and fixes. The Byterunners team is continuously working on improving the game as far as bugs and shortcomings go. Also, they’ve finally been able to focus on adding stuff as well!
There are more features in the works, waiting to be deployed in future updates.

Boats will now have the ability to dock anywhere on the map, not just at predefined ports. Just point the bow of your boat towards a flat piece of land, and when you see the docking prompt, you’re good to go! Yachts will remain as they are… for now.
The world map now has clearly marked borders between regions, and displays their names.
You can see the crafting queue visualization when hovering over crafters.
Added buttons for the manual setting of the amount of packaged drugs.
Fixed a bug where an amount confirmation window popped up when moving only one portion of drugs.
Fixed (this time for real) crafting timers displaying and counting time incorrectly.
Other minor fixes.
If you still experience crashes after this update, it will be very helpful for us if you report it using this form https://forms.gle/DYrWgArXqesqHcP69
Note to all who have mods: Mods may not be compatible after the game update and may cause problems. Please uninstall mods until they are up to date.
Soon to come: achievements! Stay tuned.

topNew: The world map now has clearly marked borders between regions, and displays their names.
You can see the crafting queue visualization when hovering over crafters.
Added buttons for the manual setting of the amount of packaged drugs.

items.text: Hello everyone,

Working on this update, we primarily focused on addressing some of the most critical performance issues you've shared with us so far. We’ve identified the root causes of the most frequent crashes and prioritized resolving them, yielding very promising results. Ready to dive into the changelog?
Major updates to the rendering pipeline, optimizing RAM and VRAM usage;
Implemented virtual textures to improve texture streaming performance;
Refactored navigation building to reduce CPU usage spikes.
These changes should directly resolve some of the most common crash-related issues.
Fixed a bug that caused a save created in a car on a private island to prevent further gameplay after it was loaded;
Fixed a bug where the production rate multiplier worked incorrectly when crafting multiple items;
Fixed a bug where UI production times in crafters were incorrect;
Fixed a bug where a special client from Peninsula, Moises Biel (now Gerald Saint) has the same name as one of the Prison Camp workers;
Fixed a bug where in the production chain of cocaine the Laboratory Oven is not included;
Fixed a bug where the names of drug mixes do not appear in drug shortage messages;
Fixed a bug where an official in Bahia de Oro hovers in the air;
Fixed a bug where after changing a tab in the setting the player received an incorrect message about unsaved changes;
Fixed a bug where furniture cannot be placed in the underground safe in the “Villa at the Waterfall” hideout;
Other minor changes.
If you still experience crashes after this update, it will be very helpful for us if you report it using this form https://forms.gle/DYrWgArXqesqHcP69
Note to all who have mods: Mods may not be compatible after the game update and may cause problems. Please uninstall mods until they are up to date.
Happy playing!
Hello, Dealers!

A new fix-centred update is now available, addressing a variety of issues. Before you read the patch notes, remember that if you find any problems with the game, you can report them to us - read more in this thread.
The Byterunners team and all of us at Movie Games remain committed to supporting, improving and expanding your DDS2 experience.
Fixed an issue where a player could get locked by approaching policemen while sitting in a car
Fixed an issue where new backup saves stop displaying
Fixed an issue where pets would be blocked by storing away their beddings
Fixed an issue where if Jean died during the quest “Escort Jean to Benita” it was impossible to complete the quest “Inform Benita on her brother's fate”
Fixed an issue where Jean could get blocked on a step in a cave
Fixed an issue where distributors were not distributing mixes to dealers
Fixed an issue where mixes could not be removed from crafting query
Fixed an issue where mixes could not have been properly passed to dealers
Fixed an issue where mixes were not displayed correctly for guests at craft stations after loading the game
Fixed an issue where it was not possible to add/remove mixes from favorites
Fixed an issue where recipe filtering, in the crafter's UI, did not work for custom mixes
Fixed an issue where fog of war could reappear on the map in places previously discovered after loading the game
Removed duplicate Poppy milk recipe from stove
Fixed an issue where a 5 liter bottle of water added only 4 kg of water to the substance storage.
Fixed incorrect information in tooltip in furniture mode about the cost conversion rate for removing waste in hideouts
Fixed an issue where clients in Volcano Island could spawn in a building
Fixed an issue where a player could get blocked while climbing a ladder
Fixed an issue where planted poppies looked like marijuana
Fixed the instances of soldiers' AI functioning improperly during a villa raid
Fixed an issue where, after appointing numerous customers for the same time, some of them might not show up at the right place
Fixed incorrect road collision in port town
Fixed an issue where an NPC could get blocked during the “Follow the guide” quest
Fixed an issue where Javier’s marker would not appear on the map
Fixed an issue where recipes removed from favorites would become favorites again after loading the game
Fixed an issue with being locked on black screen after death
Added possibility of quick travel to private island
Added a feature that Jean will teleport to the player if they get too far apart
Improved multiple aspects in parkour mechanic
Multiple improvements and additions to the map
If you had a game crash during gameplay, it will be very helpful for us if you report it using this form https://forms.gle/DYrWgArXqesqHcP69

We are aware of a bug where some players' saves disappear. We were able to figure out that this problem occurs when you run the game on one computer on 2 different accounts (e.g., thanks to the family sharing option). We are investigating this problem and looking at ways to fix this, but it may take some time. For the moment we recommend enabling the Steam Cloud option, this is possible after entering the properties of the game, so that the saves will also be saved in the cloud and this will eliminate the risk of losing all your saves permanently.
Note to all who have mods: Mods may not be compatible after the game update and may cause problems. Please uninstall mods until they are up to date.
Hello everyone,
Today the dev team brings you a language hotfix. Find the patch notes below.
Fixed an issue in Turkish and Korean languages where engine codes were displayed along with the texts
Fixed problems with missing translations, typos and other deficiencies across all languages
If you find any language problems, please report them to us in the comments or in the Steam bug thread, and they will be fixed in future updates.
Hello everyone,
It's our pleasure to inform you that the new patch is already available. This update focuses on multiple large-scale general improvements to the game including performance.
Added Korean language.

Fixed a bug where changing keybind settings did not activate the apply button, which made it impossible to save the new keybinds without using a workaround (like changing settings from other sections).

Reworked, optimised and fixed multiple issues considering graphics settings and DLSS settings, which caused medium to severe performance issues for both AMD and Nvidia graphics card users (problems occurring when saving settings, defaulting settings or simply loading up the game with saved over graphics settings.

Reconfigured some aspects of the map section and 3D model loading, reassigned multiple map objects and object classes to different configurations to improve detail loading and possibly reduce the number of hitches and freezes for some players as well as reduce memory usage.
Implemented improvements to all environment NPCs for memory and performance reasons.
Added more "life" by populating multiple locations with NPCs and additional enviro details.

Reworked and/or optimised multiple world collision settings for roads, bridges, tunnels, barriers and multiple small and medium world 3D models to improve world interactions and navigational mesh navigation for AI opponents.
Optimised interior and exterior world objects in the context of AI navigational mesh generation, which may improve CPU usage and CPU performance spikes for some players.

Added multiple environment NPCs in mid and late-game areas of the map in exteriors as well as interiors to bring more life to the world and made multiple visual and animation improvements for environment NPCs all over the map.
Reworked player character ladder interaction and ladder movement.
Improved player movement collision capsule and camera work issues for the player character, mostly for crouched movement and world interaction glitches.
Fixed issues with buying a coke lab from Luca.
Fixed an issue where you could glitch furniture through walls in some hideouts.
Fixed multiple instances of collision issues with environment objects and buildings.
Fixed instances of missing landscape on the map, causing players to fall under it.
Fixed multiple instances of missing materials on buildings and environment elements.
Fixed multiple instances of places where players could parkour under the map.
Fixes issues where some clients and NPC would levitate or generally be out of place.
Fixed issue where dealer spots were not shown on the map in Bahia de Oro.
Implemented multiple improvements to foliage and fixed multiple instances of foliage levitating and being misplaced.
Multiple improvements to interior lighting behaviour and optimization.
Another update is in the works.
Note to all who have mods: Mods may not be compatible after the game update and may cause problems. Please uninstall mods until they are up to date.

Hey folks, the time is now! Thanks for your patience, we’re thrilled to share with you the new update. It’s big and significant - as its name suggests. Many of the issues we dealt with were crucial in the context of the entire game and took us a considerable amount of time.
Additionally, we’ve added new content, including language versions and a whole new island with a purchasable mansion!
We hope that your experience will be better and more satisfying. As always, share your feedback!

Fixed a crash related to the audio cache system that occurred while traveling the map, especially long distances on boats. Optimized and improved environment audio systems for fewer issues, improved RAM usage and CPU performance
Fixed a crash (fatal error) that could sometimes occur during crafting, especially after updates and/or installing mods
Fixed issues related to Luca and coke lab quest, fixed issue with blocked lab finding task. The fix is retroactive
Fixed an issue where you could not obtain door or window upgrades remotely via the furniture mode, added the ability to do that
Added a temporary fix for the interaction with the priest where he could be locked in some circumstances
Blocked the ability to drop drug items (blunts, cookies etc.) to dealers. This was not intended, dealers with special clients assigned will produce the items themselves from the provided dope
Fixed a bug with the displayed cost prediction for waste removal in the hideout management screen
Fixed a bug where the “Dresser” could not be stored or moved
Fixed a bug where it was possible to buy a crowbar from Tom the Tech infinitely
Fixed a bug where a placed door lock on a door appears in the wrong place
Fixed a bug where some boats have the incorrect tank size in the description
Fixed a bug where it was impossible to sell some necklace
Fixed a dealer spot where the dealer is standing partly under the ground
Improved parkour and parkour animation for the player character, introduced new smoother and more natural feel and added some technical improvements
Reduced the amounts of items that are needed to be gathered in the endgame shipping container quest
Reduced fall damage for both player HP as well as for shoes and clothing, reduced the increase of fall damage due to inventory weight
Introduced new 3D models for special equipment (boss' desk, distributor desk, DIY table, Lab Tech station, Chemistry station)
Improved lighting (visually as well as performance-wise) for all hideout custom light sources (lamps etc.)
Added a visual indicator for enemy aggro level on the player HUD
Improved issues with the enviro sense, added more objects to the detection
Added regular inventory slots to the wardrobes so you can also use them as item storage
Improvements to NPC population and life in a couple of endgame and late game locations

releases.displayName: Devlog: Future update plans for DDS2

items.text: Hi all!
The DDS Madness 2.0 is in full swing - so it’s about time to tell you Rafal’s plans for future updates! Or at least tease some of them.
First of all, the team at Byterunners plans to keep supporting the base game, so you can expect more to come than just the upcoming update that we’ve announced.

There is a list of things that Rafal et consortes want to introduce, but the order in which these will be added is not set in stone. That’s why for now we’ll only reveal _some_ of the changes to come.
There will be many graphical and lighting and environment improvements. The game will look better and more lively.

Byterunners are improving the first-person and third-person parkour animations and camera movements, smoothening them, so the jumps look good when you do them and when you watch your co-op players do them.
There will be a new private island that you can buy, with a big, rich villa that you can move into, customize, and turn into another base of operations.
New drugs are incoming, which we already teased.
You can expect quality-of-life improvements, so changes that will make the game be easier to control, more intuitive, simply more pleasant to play.
There will be many new fixes to the bugs reported either by you or the QA.

Controller support is in the works. It is partially made already, but in order to allow you to play the game using the controller 95% of the time, changes to the UI and other things need to be considered.

Apart from that, there will be new interesting features which we don’t want to reveal just yet. At this point they’re work-in-progress, still being shaped. Once we finalize them, we’ll let you know what they are.

With all the events on the road before us, we hope that your time with DDS2 will evolve into a richer, deeper experience. Besides, our sale is on, you know about the Casino DLC (which is being made by another team), so bright days are ahead.
See you on Isla Sombra!
Dealers, patch #4 is here and it addresses a lot of issues and introduces some new features requested by y’all. Shall we dive in?

Fixed multiple replication issues for joining players and reworked parts of the net code for more data flow stability. The fixes are retroactive and will work with saved games where the problems occurred:

Fixed a bug where in some more advanced gameplays joining players would not get data of cartel employees and clients, resulting in workstation assignment issues, client and employee avatar and data issues, sms data issues;
Fixed bugs considering map marker replication and discovered markers disappearing after reloading the game, also fixed issues that could occur in single-player sessions.

Fixed a bug where joining players would have their fog of war reset after each session rejoin and/or game load. The fix is not retroactive, as the data is lost but the FOW will keep saving properly from now on. (Keep in mind the point of FOW save is the point of game save, so if you disconnect the fog may reset to the state when you’ve last saved the cartel progress);

Fixed a bug with the Benita questline, where Jean would reset if we saved and loaded while leading him to Benita. Now after load, he will wait close to his original position to be reacquired by a player and follow the first player that comes close (trying to phrase the description to avoid spoilers). The fix should work retroactively if the escort task is active on the load;
Fixed a bug with the Benita questline where when we get defeated in the fight the questline might bug out. This fix might not be retroactive for some players;
Fixed issues concerning morphine vial stacking while crafting them on the DIY table;

Fixed over 170 occurrences of translation issues – untranslated elements, Polish phrases and other translation problems all over the project (dialogues, radial menus, UI, names and descriptions, call-to-action phrases and many others). Some individual phrases may sometimes come up as we are constantly changing and adding things to the game and translating the texts in batches;
Added object count optimizations to reduce the chance of object pool overflow crashes that occurred for some of the players;
Fixed a bug where water could fill the substance storage after cancelling crafts in hideouts with running water (now the water is not being returned anymore);
Fixed a bug where in some cases hideout doors could stay blocked after a raid occurred;
Fixed multiple bugs concerning hideouts (furniture placement issues and more);
Fixed a bug where the FPS limit setting would reset after closing and opening the game;
Fixed a bug where in some cases the player could not talk to the priest influencer;
Fixed an issue with the task to „Learn about obtaining citizenship” when the citizenship was already obtained;
Fixed a bug where the cocaine leaves delivery would be unavailable after loading a saved game;
Fixed a bugged client spawn in one location, where the client would spawn inside a wall.

items.text: Reworked the furniture mode, improved it visually and added new features;

Changed the waste mechanics to a billing mechanism similar to power and water usage. The waste will no longer use substance storage space, and the bill will be automatically withdrawn from your wealth daily just like power. The change is retroactive, the accumulated substance waste will be automatically converted to the bill on load. The trash bins do not work anymore, but they stayed as they will serve a purpose later on;
Significantly reduced the cost of waste removal from B5 per gram to B2;

Added the feature to disable drugs from being sold on certain territories. Disabled drugs will not receive new orders and their demand will slowly drain while they remain disabled. Some of the players are experiencing crashes due to a conflict with some Intel i9 processors and the Unreal Engine 5 decompression method. We are not able to deliver a direct fix, but there is an available workaround that will fix the issue for most cases.
For who?: People with 13th and 14th gen Intel processors & those who experience "LowLevelFatalError - Could not decompress shader group with Oodle" crashes
What's the problem?: Hardware issue with Intel 13900K and 14900K (and more, like 13700, 14700) processors causing game crashes due to BIOS settings and high clock rates.
How to fix (Short explanation): Players should disable overclocking in BIOS or use Intel XTU to lower the Performance Core multiplier for stability.
Step by step guide to fix the problem: https://www.radgametools.com/oodleintel.htm (use the link and scroll down a bit for a step by step guide for fixing this problem).

Open settings
Click apply
Exit settings
Reopen settings

releases.displayName: FAQ: sequel, update, behind the scenes & more

items.text: Hey everyone!

Rafal here, the game director of DDS1 and 2. I’m floored by the amount of feedback we got from you regarding both games after we announced part 2. First of all, thanks for the effort you took to respond. I’d like to address as many issues that you’ve raised as possible, and together with Movie Games we figured that it’ll be best to prepare a proper FAQ.
We’ll combine questions about both games here, because you usually asked about the development process, and how one game affects the other. Well, find out below. :)
You can read this FAQ both on the DDS1 and DDS2 Steam page.
Frequently Asked Questions
1. So is DDS2 really a prequel?
Indeed, it is a prequel. You will experience Eddie's rise to the high cartel ranks at Isla Sombra. In a way - you write his story. You do not need to know the events of DDS1 to enjoy DDS2.

We wanted to keep the core of DDS1 heart and gameplay while giving the game its own identity, thus the new setting. We decided that Eddie's backstory will be perfect for both introducing a fresh setting as well as new gameplay challenges by running the business "the old way".

I think that we all like Eddie and that he deserves his own larger chunk of the story, more than he was given in part 1. I also believe Eddie’s popularity is in huge part due to Christopher Neal’s fantastic performance, and I’m happy to confirm that Chris will narrate DDS2.
2. Will DDS2 get updates? How frequently?

Taking our experiences as well as mistakes from the first part, we want to deliver DDS2 as a larger, much more full and polished experience at premiere point. Aside from that the game will still get support as long as it will need it. Expansions might also come, but time will tell.
3. Does DDS2 mean you’re dropping DDS1?

Not dropping. Completing. We want Endgame to be the final update that ties up all the loose ends and adds much more stuff for you to play with. We’ve been supporting DDS and publishing free updates for 2 years. It’s time to move on, because we’ve reached the limit of what we can do with the DDS technical framework.

This being the last content update does not mean end of support though. We will still be there to fix issues and bugs as far as the game core allows us to. We are also including a lot of requested QoL changes with the Endgame patch.
4. What about guns and the stuff you showed in the first DDS1 trailer?
Yes, that trailer is haunting us to this day. All I can say is that neither myself nor Movie Games would publish this trailer today. So what happened?

Well, first of all - the original DDS1 announcement was made during a very early stage of production, when the game was a vision in prototyping - if I may call it that way. As we dug deeper into assembling the core gameplay, we came to realize that some of the features we envisioned in the game either won't actually work well for the gameplay or quite simply - we won't be able to make them. At least not well enough for us to be acceptable.

First of all - that is a normal part of the game development process, but - as a fairly inexperienced developer at that time - I wasn't able to fully foresee it. Secondly, the guns in the trailer (as one of the examples) were more of a "cinematic enhancement", and, collectively, we wrongly assumed that they won't be treated as a promised gameplay feature. This was a wrong assumption. We understand that now.

We can't turn back time, but we sure can - and did - learn from our mistakes. Additionally, shooting - as fun as it may sound in theory - would ruin the balance and low-profile playstyle of DDS also introducing numerous additional issues we were not up for solving. That is why we scrapped the idea in early stages.

I know and understand that some of you felt cheated by that and I am truly sorry. We are all just people and make mistakes. Now, as we know the IP much better and learned from our mistakes - we are able to have more control over what the end form of our game will be. DDS2 is a different story and I'm convinced you'll love it, just as we do. No guns tho... as we already established :)
5. Will all the things from the DDS2 trailer be in the game, or will it be a DDS1 deja vu?

The DDS1 announcement was a huge lesson for everyone involved. We made sure to not include anything in the DDS2 trailer that would not appear in the game. I mean, it would’ve been really stupid of us to repeat the same mistake, right?

The DDS2 trailer is obviously cinematic but uses a lot of actual in-game assets and was made much further into prototyping the gameplay. We still have a lot of work ahead, but the core gameplay is set and well thought through. All the shown scenes have their "in-game relatives". The time for a gameplay reveal, and footage of how exactly we combined these elements in the game itself, will come when we are ready to show them.

Surely - some minor changes might and probably will come. In the end, all that matters is the good of the game as a whole, but what we've shown you are core elements of the actual gameplay. There is also more to it, but we leave the best for last. :)
6. So will DDS2 have all the stuff the fans have been wanting?

Surely not ALL, as there are a lot of dreams and ideas out there, but in the second installment we did our best to combine our own vision, and what is best in DDS1, with all the knowledge and ideas we took from the community. We want it to be a much better version of the original. In short we're adding everything that is reasonable and doable while maintaining our core vision.

There is a much larger world with more to do, better AI, way better and more complex cartel progress (from street level to boss) and much more engaging drug production/distribution system. The player has more control over his strategies, assortment and playstyle. We want it to fit the huge engagement and commitment of the game's community which we did not expect initially for DDS1. Also - there are a few really big and great features that we'll announce if we are fully certain we have control over. But more on that will come later.

Bottom line: We expanded DDS1 to the limits of the original technical core, added what made sense but a lot of it was just much better to save for a fresh, better designed from scratch game, made with larger experience and MUCH newer technology. Stay tuned for more info on what's to come.
7. Why is the DDS1 update taking so long?

First things first - it's a big update. It introduces a couple of new mechanics as well as an endgame questline. We are also adding many community requested quality-of-life improvements and features, Steam Achievements and more as well as fixing lots of old bugs. That alone is a lot of testing, polishing as well as balancing with the new features in the loop.

Additionally - DDS1 expanding and changing is very time consuming and complicated. First - as we established in earlier questions - its technical core is simply badly made in various ways and cannot be fully remade or fixed. Fixing issues brings new issues, reworks break game files, unchangeable modules have to be worked around and so on. Maintaining the stability of saved games on various levels of progress is a big part of it too. Obviously with that in mind we have to quadruple check different save files, fresh playthroughs, late game playthroughs and so on with EACH iteration.

Again - that's a huge part why we decided to start fresh and incorporate part of our plan for the "perfect DDS" in a new game which is DDS2. Trust me - that's really the best way to go and you won't be disappointed. :)
8. Did DDS2 slow the development of the update?

Only partially, for most of the time DDS2 was prototyped and developed by an additional group of people, but under our guidance - for obvious reasons. Now the time has come for us to jump in fully to maximize DDS2 experience and it is time to put the DDS1 expansion to a proper end.
9. DDS on consoles

We’ve been trying to make it happen for a long time, but here’s something you might not know. Console platform owners have to approve your game on their platform. They have much, much stricter content rules than Steam, and in general they don’t want “problematic” games. Adult games won’t ever come out on consoles. And when you have a game where you distribute drugs and use them, it is extremely difficult to convince the platforms to put it next to cute purple dragons and bandicoots.

You can say: but what about game X or Y? It has drugs and it’s on consoles! Yes, but usually drugs are just a minor part of these titles, or they’re stigmatized and portrayed as bad. This kinda isn’t the case with DDS.

So: we’ll keep trying to make it happen, but I wouldn’t hold my breath. It’s not because of the lack of will. It’s because we made a game called Drug Dealer Simulator. :) If you want DDS on consoles, maybe it would be best to tell this to PlayStation or Xbox. When they see a lot of people voicing it, they might reconsider.
10. Will there be controller support for DDS1 and DDS2?

Yes, we redesigned the input complexity and UI of the original, and we are trying to adapt it for gamepads. We also added features like radial menus and so on for making the interface as clean and friendly as possible.
11. What engine will DDS2 run on?
Unreal Engine 5. Currently it's the only reasonable choice. :)
12. Will there be Steam Deck support for DDS2?
There is Steam Deck support for DDS1, so I can’t see why not. We would sure want it to run on the Deck, but who knows what future holds.
13. Will there be an OST for DDS2?
Yes, we are making some awesome OST for the game and will make it available to you outside the game as well. Maybe besides some licensed songs that we won't have control over.
14. Will there be a fleshed-out gang hierarchy in DDS2?

Yes, the gang hierarchy in DDS2 is much more complex. You will be able to assign various tasks to your minions as well as assign clients to dealers to let you focus on more high-level business and more.
15. Will there be a demo or a beta?

Movie Games releases demos for most of their games and the plan is to have one for DDS2 as well. We will inform you when it might drop. In the meantime, stay tuned for Discord and Steam announcements as we might start a closed early alpha testing stage for the community at one point. No promises yet though.
Alright!
I think that covers all of the repeatedly asked questions. If you didn’t get a reply to yours, sorry about that. Comment below and the team will do their best to respond.
Thanks for sticking with us, wishlist and follow the game to support us. See you in Endgame in November, and on Isla Sombra next year!
